name: Effect Monitor
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: Shantek
description: A lightweight client-side mod that notifies you when your potion effects are about to expire.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: Warns in chat when an active effect has 60, 30 or 5 seconds left ('⏳ Speed ends in 30s'), with a drum sound.
note: Not yet: Its config screen and its two keys (no default) can't be used.
